steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: setup
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); })()

steps.name: arm
steps.eval: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.finish-picker button[aria-label*="yedropper"], .finish-picker button[title*="yedropper"], .finish-picker button[aria-label*="ample"]'); if (!b) throw new Error('no eyedropper button: ' + [...document.querySelectorAll('.finish-picker .icon-btn, .finish-picker header button')].map(x => x.getAttribute('aria-label') || x.getAttribute('title') || x.textContent.trim()).join('|')); b.click(); })()

steps.name: simulate-sample
steps.eval: (async () => { const m = await import('/src/materials/sampleFinish.ts'); const s = window.__store.getState(); const sample = m.resolveSampledFinish({ kind: 'wall', roomId: 'livingDining' }, s.finishes, s.floorPlan); s.setSampledFinish(sample); window.__sampled = sample; })()

steps.name: apply-elsewhere
steps.eval: (async () => { const fd = await import('/src/materials/finishDrop.ts'); const ap = await import('/src/state/finishDropApply.ts'); ap.applyFinishDropAction(fd.resolveFinishDrop({ kind: 'wall', roomId: 'mainBedroom' }, { finishId: window.__sampled.finishId })); })()
